name: scene-to-art-lab
title_zh: 把一张照片改造成竖版艺术海报的七种画风工坊
tagline_zh: 旅行照、人像、街景，别再只调滤镜。水彩、波普丝网、水墨、浮世绘……一张原图，产出可展出的 3:4 海报。
tagline_en: Stop at filters. Your travel shot, portrait, or street scene becomes a gallery-ready 3:4 poster — watercolor, pop.
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied photograph into an original vertical 3:4 art-directed poster using watercolor, pop-art screenprint, expressive painting, ink-wash, relief print, editorial surrealism, or a controlled hybrid. Use when the user asks to reinterpret a real scene, portrait, object, vehicle, landscape, architecture, or travel photo as creative visual art, an exhibition poster, editorial poster,
why_zh: 不是贴一层风格化滤镜，而是按画种重构图、色板与笔触逻辑，七种风格可叠加成受控混合体。
why_en: Not a filter overlay — it rebuilds composition, palette, and stroke logic per art movement, with a controlled hybrid mode.
limit_zh: 仅处理单张照片输入，不生成新场景；只输出 3:4 竖版海报，横版或方形需自行裁切；七种风格之外的自定义画风不支持。
limit_en: Single photo in, no scene generation; output fixed to 3:4 vertical, other ratios need manual crop; only 7 built-in styles, hybrid limited to two.
title_en: Turn one photo into a vertical art poster in 7 painterly.
